title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. trunciloba
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. trunciloba, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a variety of the common lady's mantle plant (Alchemilla vulgaris), characterized by its unique leaf morphology. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diarrheal properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. trunciloba include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can help soothe digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits.
